投稿者: Ian 南アフリカのCEO レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "LIFE made simple with ZAUI"
良い点: Onboarding with ZAUI was unlike any system we had tried or worked with before. Our agent kept us up to date on our progress and stayed in constant contact. Even one of the directors met with us in an online meeting to welcome us to the system. Our clients love the system, as it makes it much easier for them to book and pay for our services online. The report structure is amazing and allows us to compile custom reports. This way, we know exactly how we did in any given month and can track expenses versus income seamlessly. Clients' payments are secure and protected by the online payment portal ZAUI works with. Travel bookings have never been simpler for our clients and staff than it is with ZAUI.
改善点: Compared to the systems we used before, ZAUI costs quite a bit more to run as a system, but we also receive way more than before.

タイトル: Support and a True Partnership Approach
投稿者: Jose カナダのFinance and Operations Manager エンタテインメント, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Support and a True Partnership Approach"
良い点: Zaui is a robust and flexible reservation platform that works particularly well for tourism operators. It provides strong booking and operational functionality, good reporting capabilities, and plenty of options to configure the system around the needs of the business. We’ve also been very impressed with the support and engagement from the Zaui team. They have been receptive to feedback, proactive in showing us newer capabilities, and genuinely interested in helping us optimize how we use the platform rather than simply selling us software.
改善点: With the amount of functionality available, the system can take some time to fully understand and configure, particularly when inheriting an account that has been built up over several years. Some areas of the interface and workflows could also be more intuitive. That said, many of these challenges can be addressed through proper setup, training, and working closely with the Zaui team.

投稿者: Amy カナダのOwner 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "I do not recommend Zaui"
良い点: There really is nothing I can say that is positive about Zaui. The system is overwhelming and complex.
改善点: **Unreliable, overly complicated and difficult to manage** Our experience with Zaui has been extremely frustrating. The system is overly complex, overwhelming to configure and requires far too much manual monitoring for something that is supposed to simplify operations. We experienced countless errors with availability, capacity, blocked departures and the GetYourGuide and Viator integrations. Information did not reliably sync, bookings came through when they should not have, and we could never feel confident that the inventory displayed across the different platforms was accurate. You simply cannot rely on the system without constantly checking everything yourself. Support was also inconsistent. We received conflicting or incomplete information, and staff often could not explain a straightforward way to configure or manage the system. Important setup requirements were only identified after serious problems occurred. Rather than receiving a clear solution, we repeatedly had to open new tickets, explain the situation again and spend hours troubleshooting. Billing information provided by support also conflicted with how we were ultimately charged, further undermining our confidence in the company. I do not recommend Zaui.

タイトル: Moderately satisfied and sure hoping things get better
投稿者: Stefanie カナダのDirector レジャー、旅行、観光, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Moderately satisfied and sure hoping things get better"
良い点: The same people answer my questions, and for the most part have been able to solve things that are system critical. It keeps all of our bookings in one place, and we can set the parameters of each trip to be different. Adding products like rental items to an activity is a nice addition. When I'm signed out after a period of inactivity and I sign back in, I am returned to whatever page I was working on. I like that.
改善点: When I am creating a new activity, I have to have already creating my pricing code for it (there is no way to click on pricing and be taken to a pop up that lets me add a new pricing product). So I have to open up another window and go to pricing and then make a new one.There are way too many options, so it makes moving around through Zaui just terrible to learn for a new person. It would be great if you could customize the features that you use, so that only they show up for a user (for instance, I only ever use a direct link HTML to embed my zaui booking page into my website. I have to go to embeds and widgets and each time, select direct HTML link, it doesn't keep that as my default. Oh, and even better than this, would be that once I finish an activity and save it, that the link would pop up automatically on the same page so that I don't have to go through the process of finding it each time - and if I have a separate window open with the trips, I have to refresh it each time I add a new trip, and then that puts me back at having to select direct HTML link again). It's slow, cumbersome, and doesn't autosave. The save button should be at the bottom of pages as well as the top. Lots of other things, unfortunately, are frustrating and I believe could be simplified and made more effective to work in the back end.
